DXC Technology Co is listed as a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, trading under the ticker DXC, with CIK 0001688568. The text harvested from the website given for the company does not describe DXC Technology. It describes Dexus, which the text calls an Australasian real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development business with four decades of experience, listed on the ASX under DXS. The same text refers to Atlassian Central in Sydney reaching a full height of more than 180 metres, to a redundant Brisbane office converted into 1,180 student beds, and to a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It also carries a disclaimer that the information is general only, is subject to change, and that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

No AI products are tracked for DXC Technology Co, and no MCP servers are recorded for it. The site text contains no AI product claims, describing instead real estate and infrastructure funds and assets.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Virginia, with a count of 152. No lawsuits are listed for it.
